subtitle: Your workspace, understood. Your actions, accounted for.
unavailable: AI is unavailable for this account or plan.
clientContext: Context is limited to the current client.
contextFailed: Unable to load this context. Choose another area or reopen the assistant.
helpDescription: Ask for an analysis, a draft or specific actions. Review the sources and select what to execute.
noHistory: Your recent requests will appear here.
working: Reviewing the context and preparing the result…
failed: Unable to complete the request. Check the history before trying again.
cancelled: Request cancelled. Any usage already incurred remains recorded.
sampleNote: Sources are a limited recent sample. The response is a snapshot at the displayed time; it may contain errors. Review before using or sharing.
confirm: I reviewed the selected actions and their edited values.
confirmSharing: I reviewed the client-facing text, removed internal information and authorize publication to this project's current client portal.
placeholder: Describe the outcome, relevant project and constraints…
automatic: For this request, authorize automatic creation and planning of internal tasks. If the plan includes other action types, all actions remain for review.
title: Title
questions: Briefing questions (one per line; blank for an information request)

default.analyze: Summarize this context, cite the sources and identify missing information.
default.act: Propose the next concrete actions. Do not invent dates or estimates.
default.brief: Prepare a concise update for the client. Omit internal costs and private information.

projects.analyze: Summarize progress, deliverables, blockers and the next decisions with sources.
projects.act: Create a draft task plan from the available briefing. Identify questions before assuming scope.
projects.brief: Prepare a briefing request for this project's client with the unanswered questions.

leads.analyze: Review these leads and identify who needs attention, explaining the evidence.
leads.act: Propose follow-ups for leads without one scheduled. Ask me for dates if none were provided.
leads.brief: Draft a personalized follow-up message using the available lead information.

scope.analyze: Compare requested changes with the approved proposal. Separate evidence, uncertainty and additional work.
scope.act: Draft tasks for the requested change, without claiming the scope has been approved.
scope.brief: Explain the scope difference in client-friendly language without internal costs.

capacity.analyze: Explain this week's capacity and overload using the calculated report. Highlight incomplete data.
capacity.act: Propose a redistribution of standalone tasks considering capacity, dates and access. Preserve dates unless necessary.
capacity.brief: Summarize the planning decisions that require human input.

financial.analyze: Explain the components of the recorded margin, its period, currency and missing costs. Do not invent values.
financial.act: Identify which missing records should be reviewed to improve financial reliability.
financial.brief: Draft a neutral client update about pending invoices without exposing internal costs.

time.analyze: Review my recent time records and identify incomplete entries. Do not invent worked hours.
time.act: List the specific records that need my attention and explain why.
time.brief: Prepare a factual summary of the work recorded.

errors.AGENT_INTERNAL_ONLY: The agent is available only to internal staff.
errors.ACCESS_CHANGED: Access changed. Start a new request with the current context.
errors.CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND: The selected context is no longer available.
errors.CONTEXT_TOO_LARGE: Select a single project to reduce the context.
errors.INVALID_AI_OUTPUT: The generated response could not be validated. No actions were executed.
errors.INVALID_AI_SOURCES: The response referenced an unavailable source. No actions were executed.
errors.INVALID_AI_ACTION: The proposed action could not be validated. No actions were executed.
errors.SOURCE_CHANGED: A source changed after generation. Create a new plan before applying it.
errors.TASK_REQUIRES_PLANNING: A selected task has dependencies, subtasks or is completed. Review it in project planning.
errors.ASSIGNEE_UNAVAILABLE: The selected person cannot access this project or is no longer active.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: The plan's task limit has been reached.
errors.CLIENT_REQUIRED: This project needs a client with active portal access.
errors.REQUEST_LIMIT: The organization has reached its open client request limit.
errors.DRAFT_EXPIRED: This draft is older than 24 hours. Generate a fresh plan.
errors.ALREADY_APPLIED: This request was already executed with another selection. Check its history.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the fields, dates and selected actions.
errors.INVALID_SELECTION: The selected actions are invalid. Reopen the result.
errors.RUN_NOT_READY: This request is not ready for execution.
errors.SHARING_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: Review and confirm publication to the client portal.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider is unavailable. Check the request history before starting another generation.
errors.AGENT_FAILED: Unable to complete the request. Check its history before trying again.
errors.ACTION_FAILED: The response is ready, but automatic execution failed. Review the actions.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your role does not permit this action.

legacyDescription: Review the extracted fields before creating the record. Nothing is created until you confirm.
